t: Сотрудникам и ветеранам Федеральной службы по финансовому мониторингу

te: Employees and veterans of the Federal Service for Financial Monitoring
de: Dear friends! I congratulate you on your significant anniversary – the 25th anniversary of the Federal Financial Monitoring Service. For a quarter of a century, your Service has grown into one of the key structures in the field of economic security. Thanks…
